description: Known-ODE model (the generator's equation with learned recurrent time constant, resting potential, and connection weights W) evaluated on degraded flyvis_known_ode data, model noise sigma 0.05, embedding dim 0, 1 epoch, batch 4, 35 data-augmentation loops, fp32 MLP precision, L1 regulariser 1e-05. Three edge-degraded conditions: 400% added null edges, 20% removed edges, 50% removed edges, dataset flyvis_noise_005_null_edges_pc_400_blank50_cv00. Five-fold cross-validation (folds cv00-cv04), 15 of 15 runs landed; metrics compared across the three edge conditions.
facts:
CAPTION: Known-ODE evaluation across degraded versions of the Flyvis training data: model and measurement noise, added/removed connectivity edges. The published Known-ODE runs, re-analysed with the paper’s current analysis code (experiment 15). Five-fold cross-validation (mean ± SD). Prediction: metrics comp SECTION: edges
FACTS:
- experiment: 15: Known ODE re-analysed on degraded Flyvis-217 data
- arm: kode
- runs: 15 of 15 landed
- cells: condition: flyvis_noise_005_null_edges_pc_400, flyvis_noise_005_removed_pc_20, flyvis_noise_005_removed_pc_50
- dataset: flyvis_noise_005_null_edges_pc_400_blank50_cv00
- model: flyvis_known_ode
- embedding dim: 0
- model noise sigma: 0.05
- epochs: 1
- batch: 4
- data augmentation loop: 35
- training: one-step
- MLP precision: fp32
- regularisers: W_L1 1e-05
GLOSSARY (meaning of identifier fragments; use only these):
- blank50: in every video clip of the stimulus, the first 50% of the frames are replaced by blank frames
- cv00 .. cv04: cross-validation folds 0 to 4
- noise_free / noise_005 / noise_05: model noise sigma 0 / 0.05 / 0.5
- 010 / 020 after noise_005: measurement noise gamma 0.1 / 0.2
- flyvis_conductance: code name of the general-form GNN, g_phi = MLP(a_i, a_j, v_i, v_j)
- flyvis_known_ode: code name of the Known-ODE model (the generator's equation with learned W, tau, V_rest)
- condl25 / condl100: group lasso 25 / 100 on g_phi's input groups
- null_edges_pc_400 / null400: 400% extra null edges added to the connectome
- removed_pc_20 / rm20, removed_pc_50 / rm50: 20% / 50% of the edges removed
- hidden_020 / hid20, hid10: 20% / 10% of the neurons hidden
- s5h06 / s5h21: one frame in five observed, rollout horizon 6 / 21
- INR_davis: stimulus not given, learned by a SIREN network
- full_eye_flywireRF / e8_flywireRF: FlyWire eye / e8 hybrid connectome; proximal_nulls: with proximal null edges
